hints.inputMonitoringPermission: Enable input monitoring to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.
hints.inputMonitoringPermissionGuide:
Input Monitoring permission is required for the app to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.

Steps:
1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring.
2. If BongoCat already appears in the list, select it and click the "-" button to remove it.
3. Click the "+" button to find and add BongoCat.
4. Restart the app for the permission to take effect.
hints.administratorPermission: Running the app as administrator helps capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably.
hints.administratorPermissionGuide:
To capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably, it is recommended to run the app as administrator.

How to do it:
1. Exit the app first.
2. Find the app exe or its shortcut in File Explorer.
3. Choose how to launch:
   • One-time: Right-click and choose "Run as administrator".
   • Always (default): Right-click → Properties → Compatibility tab → check "Run this program as an administrator" → OK.

hints.enabled: Turning this off disconnects immediately and stops all data sharing.
hints.relayUrl: Use your own Cloudflare Worker address, for example https://xxx.workers.dev.
hints.pairSecret: Both sides must use the same Pair Secret. It is stored in the system credential vault only, never in the settings file, and never shown in plain text.

hints.autoConnect: Connect automatically when the app starts.
hints.remoteCat: Show your partner's cat in a separate desktop window.
hints.remoteModel: Leave empty to use the same model as your own cat. Only models installed locally can be chosen.
hints.remoteStats: Requires your partner to enable "Share Input Stats" as well.
hints.shareTypingActivity: Only the hand side and typing intensity are shared, never the actual keys.
hints.sharePointer: Only the pointer's screen ratio and button state are shared, never real coordinates.
hints.shareInputStats: Off by default. When enabled, your partner sees today's and total input counts — still just numbers.
hints.pauseActivitySync: Temporarily stop sending typing and mouse activity. Chat and presence stay available.
hints.stats: Stats are stored locally; they are only sent when "Share Input Stats" is enabled.
hints.autoReturn: Typing, clicking or moving the mouse noticeably ends the away state.
hints.awayMessage: This text is shown above your cat for your partner while you are away.
hints.sendSystemNotice: Show a short notice on the remote cat window when your partner leaves or returns.
hints.presence: Your partner will see that you stepped away.
